SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT NVL(WERKS,' ') AS PLANT, NVL(BANFN,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO FROM SAPDEP.ZKEP_RE WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG in ('1','9') GROUP BY NVL(WERKS,' '), NVL(BANFN,' ')
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT NVL(MANDT,' ') AS MANDT, NVL(WERKS,' ') AS REF_IF_NO, NVL(BANFN,' ') AS QUOTATION_NO, NVL(BNFPO,' ') AS QUOTATION_SEQ, NVL(REVISION_NO,' ') AS REVISION, NVL(STATUS,' ') AS STATUS, NVL(BADAT,' ') AS ADD_DATE, NVL(LFDAT,' ') AS RD_DATE, NVL(LTRIM(TO_CHAR(MATNR),'0'),' ') AS BUYER_ITEM_NO, NVL(TXZ01,' ') AS SPECIFICATION, NVL(ZSTAN,' ') AS DESCRIPTION, NVL(MEINS,' ') AS UNIT_MEASURE, NVL(MAKER_NAME,' ') AS MAKER_NAME, NVL(PREIS, 0) AS PREV_UNIT_PRICE, NVL(ERNAM,' ') AS ADD_USER_ID, NVL(AFNAM,' ') AS REQ_USER_NAME, NVL(DEPARTMENT,' ') AS REQ_USER_DEPT, NVL(TEL_NUMBER,' ') AS REQ_USER_TEL, NVL(SMTP_ADDR,' ') AS REQ_USER_MAIL, NVL(CLOSE_DATE,' ') AS CLOSE_DATE, NVL(CLOSE_TIME,' ') AS CLOSE_TIME, NVL(MENGE, 0) AS ITEM_QTY, NVL(REMARK,' ') AS REMARK, NVL(LOEKZ,' ') AS LOEKZ FROM SAPDEP.ZKEP_RE WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG in ('1','9') AND NVL(WERKS,' ') = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND NVL(BANFN,' ') = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$' ORDER BY MANDT, WERKS,BANFN, BNFPO,REVISION_NO
UPDATE SAPDEP.ZKEP_RE SET IF_FLAG = '2', IF_DATE = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD'), IF_TIME = TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'HH24MISS') WHERE 1=1 AND IF_FLAG in ('1','9') AND NVL(WERKS,' ') = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND NVL(BANFN,' ') = '$G_RS.QUOTATION_NO$'
